name: Varus
title: the Arrow of Retribution

Q.name: Piercing Arrow
Q.description: Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by 20%. After 4 seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund 50% of its Mana cost. Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing (varies) physical damage, reduced by 15% per enemy hit (minimum 33%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to 70% based on charge time (up to to (b3ef3984) × (1 + 0.7) physical damage.
Q.summary: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

W.name: Blighted Quiver
W.description: Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional 4/10/16/22/28 + 0.3×AP + 0.2×bonus AD magic damage and apply a Blight stack for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks). Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing 0.025/0.03/0.035/0.04/0.045 + (0.01 × 0.014)×AP max Health magic damage per stack (max (0.025/0.03/0.035/0.04/0.045 + (0.01 × 0.014)×AP) × 3 max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by 11% of their Maximum per stack. Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional 0.06/0.07/0.08/0.09/0.1 missing Health magic damage, increased up to (0.06/0.07/0.08/0.09/0.1) × 1.7 missing Health damage based on charge time.
W.summary: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

E.name: Hail of Arrows
E.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage and desecrates the ground for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50% and applying 40% Grievous Wounds.
E.summary: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

R.name: Chain of Corruption
R.description: Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for 2 seconds and dealing 150/250/350 + 1×AP magic damage. Rooted enemies gain 3 Blight stacks over the duration. The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.
R.summary: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

Passive.name: Living Vengeance
Passive.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.
Passive.summary: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Ranged marksman (or lethality poke mage-marksman) built around a charged Q arrow and W Blight stacks that his other abilities detonate. Wins lanes with long-range poke and picks with the R chain root.
strengths: Very long-range Q poke, charged for range and damage
R immobilizes and spreads to nearby champions: strong pick and engage tool
E applies anti-heal (reduces healing and regeneration) and slows
Flexible builds: lethality poke or on-hit with Blight stacks
weaknesses: No dash: very vulnerable to engage and dives
Skillshot-reliant: missed Q/R means a lost trade
Charging Q slows him, so he can be punished while charging
Weak if forced into extended fights against divers

curve.lvl1: medium – Q poke or W-empowered autos, short trades only
curve.lvl6: strong – R root sets up kills with his support/jungler
curve.items: strong – first lethality item (poke) or on-hit item (Blight stacks)
curve.late: medium – R picks stay strong; immobile in teamfights

profile.curveNote: Trades from range with Q from level 1–2; the R pick threat from 6 is the real spike.
profile.waveClear: good – E and charged Q clear waves

Passive.notes: Takedowns give AD/AP for a few seconds.

Q.notes: Charged arrow: longer charge = more range/damage; slows Varus while charging.

W.notes: Passive: attacks apply Blight (on-hit); other abilities detonate it. Active empowers the next Q.

E.notes: Ground area: slows and reduces healing/regeneration (anti-heal).

R.notes: Tendril immobilizes the first champion hit, then spreads to nearby champions.

profile.windowAgainst: R down, or just after a missed Q: engage on him, he has no escape.
checks: E: is the arrow volley stopped by projectile blocks? Treated as not a projectile.
